page_title: BAR 2-1 RSO | Barcelona v Real Sociedad 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Here's the change. Pedri leaves the pitch and Marc Casado (Barcelona) comes on as a substitute.
90+3' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+3' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Barcelona.
90+2' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+1' A clumsy foul by Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
88' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
87' 3:3 – these are the offside statistics for both sides in this match.
86' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
85' The resulting corner from Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
84' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the crossbar.

84' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
83' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) attempts to feed Ferran Torres with a chip pass, but Alex Remiro reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
82' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
82' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
81' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is able to continue to play.
81' Substitution. Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) replaces Ander Barrenetxea.
79' The game is interrupted now, Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
78' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ferran Torres (Barcelona) replacing Marcus Rashford.
78' Today's match ends for Gerard Martin who will be replaced by Eric Garcia (Barcelona).

77' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) bursts into the penalty area with the ball at his feet after a wonderful individual effort that left fans breathless and in awe. However, he sends the ball in a completely different direction than intended, well wide of the target.
74' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
74' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alejandro Hernandez stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
72' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
70' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alex Remiro makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.

70' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Alex Remiro, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
68' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
68' What a great touch by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. Barcelona earn a corner.
68' 13:6 – the total goal attempt statistics. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 8:2.
67' Sergio Francisco has decided to make a change. Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) replaces Pablo Marin.
66' Substitution. Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) has come on for Benat Turrientes.
66' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
65' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.

64' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
63' The attendance is 50103.

62' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Mikel Oyarzabal, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
62' Real Sociedad take a short corner kick.
62' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar.
60' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.

59' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) alters the score to 2:1. He latched on to a good cross into the box from Lamine Yamal, steering his header from close range off the right post into the back of the net. Alex Remiro was helpless.
58' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Roony Bardghji walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
57' It's time for a substitution. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) comes on in place of Goncalo Guedes.
57' Sergio Francisco prepares a substitution. Alvaro Odriozola is replaced by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad).
56' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
55' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) attempts to find Robert Lewandowski, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

52' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The foul by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) was seen by Alejandro Hernandez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
52' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wojciech Szczesny intercepts the ball.
51' Pedri (Barcelona) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Alex Remiro easily makes the save.
51' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) is caught offside once again.
50' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
48' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ander Barrenetxea, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
47' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
46' Hansi Flick has made a change at the break. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) has come on in place of Pedro Fernandez.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Alejandro Hernandez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
45+1' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Chance! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
43' 1 - 1 Marcus Rashford sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Jules Kounde (Barcelona), who outjumps the defence to finish into the top left corner with a header. The score is 1:1.
43' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
43' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Roony Bardghji (Barcelona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Barcelona.
43' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

42' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Alex Remiro pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
39' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

39' Pedri (Barcelona) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the roof of the net that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block.
36' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
36' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
33' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
32' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:2. 3:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
31' 0 - 1 Goal! Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) scores after an assist by Ander Barrenetxea that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
30' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is caught offside yet again.
29' A pass into the penalty area from Pedri (Barcelona) is intercepted by the defence.
26' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
25' Pedro Fernandez receives a sweet pass inside the box from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.

24' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
23' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
22' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort low towards the middle of the goal and Alex Remiro easily makes the save.
21' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
17' The referee is firm and issues Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) a deserved yellow card.
16' Ball possession – 87:13.
15' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
11' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) takes it short.

10' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the bottom left corner. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Alex Remiro makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score. Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
10' The referee awards a corner and Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) goes over to take it.
10' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Good work from Barcelona as they win a corner.
9' Goncalo Guedes floats over the free kick into a crowded box. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) does well to win the ball, but sends his header just wide of the left post from close in.
8' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Hernandez signals a foul. Real Sociedad get a free kick.
7' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
6' The corner from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is intercepted by the defence.
5' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Alejandro Hernandez signals.
3' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' A crossfield pass from Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
1' The ball is cleared after Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
